nodes.label: .`invalid JSON body maps to Protocol, never crashes`()
.`a connection that never responds maps to Timeout, not a crash`()
.`a VALIDATION ErrorEnvelope body maps to Validation with the envelope's message, even on a 422`()
.`a CONFLICT ErrorEnvelope body maps to Conflict with the envelope's message`()
.`code and HTTP status mismatch defers to the envelope's code, not the status`()
.`a malformed error body falls back to the HTTP status, never crashes`()
.`an empty error body falls back to the HTTP status, never crashes`()
.`an unrecognized future error code falls back to the HTTP status, never crashes`()
